1. (Currently Amended) A system for volume management of a residual limb
prosthetic socket when the user is in a compressed stance forming a baseline and wherein the baseline shifts upwardly or downwardly based on swelling or shrinkage of the a amputated limb;a tapered prosthetic sock having a distal end and a proximal end wherein the proximal end has a thickness between 0.4 to 1.0 millimeters and the distal end has a thickness between 1.2 and 1.8 millimeters, wherein the measuring template is separate from the tapered prosthetic sock.

a measuring template further comprising a plurality of height indicators including a baseline zero mark where the baseline zero mark coincides with an upper edge of a prosthetic socket when the user is in a compressed stance forming a baseline and wherein the baseline shifts upwardly or downwardly based on swelling or shrinkage of the a amputated limb;
